facts.claim: MCP Toolbox for Databases is published on npm as @toolbox-sdk/server (latest 1.14.0, repository googleapis/mcp-toolbox, Apache-2.0); the prebuilt PostgreSQL config is selected with --prebuilt postgres and stdio with --stdio.
facts.evidence: CLI reference lists --prebuilt and --stdio ('Listens via MCP STDIO'); npm dist-tags latest 1.14.0, repository git+https://github.com/googleapis/mcp-toolbox.git.

facts.claim: The npm package ships a node launcher (bin toolbox -> bin/run.js) with per-platform optional packages, including darwin-arm64 and darwin-x64.
facts.evidence: bin {toolbox: bin/run.js}; optionalDependencies @toolbox-sdk/server-darwin-arm64 and others; the CLI docs show npx use.

facts.claim: The prebuilt postgres source reads POSTGRES_HOST (default localhost), POSTGRES_PORT (default 5432), POSTGRES_DATABASE, POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD and POSTGRES_QUERY_PARAMS from the environment; there is no single connection-string variable.
Tools: execute_sql (one SQL statement), list_tables, list_views, list_schemas, list_indexes and about 25 more catalog and statistics reads; toolsets data, monitor, health, view-config, replication.
facts.evidence: 'execute_sql: Executes a SQL query.' Toolsets defined in the prebuilt YAML.

facts.claim: get_query_plan substitutes the caller's text into EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) without parameter binding; its own description warns of SQL injection.
facts.evidence: statement: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) {{.query}}; 'Do not use this tool in production as it is prone to SQL injection risks.'

facts.claim: Toolbox says prebuilt configs are for build-time use by trusted developers and are not secure enough for run-time use with untrusted users.
facts.evidence: 'They are not secure enough for run time use cases'

facts.claim: The MCP reference package @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres (0.6.2) is marked deprecated on npm; the repository is maintained and active (pushed 2026-10-14, not archived).
facts.evidence: npm: 'Package no longer supported.'; GitHub API googleapis/mcp-toolbox archived=false pushed_at 2026-10-14.

facts.claim: list_schemas lists schemas and takes no required input (smoke op).
facts.evidence: 'list_schemas: Lists schemas in the database.' Arguments not shown on the page.

choices.because: Maintained by Google and current; the reference postgres server is deprecated and took the password on the command line.

choices.decision: every connection detail as env_refs, no inline connection string
choices.because: Toolbox reads host, database, user and password from the environment; references keep all of them out of the file.
execute_sql runs any statement; get_query_plan interpolates raw text into SQL.
a catalog read with no stated required input

open: POSTGRES_HOST, POSTGRES_DATABASE and POSTGRES_USER are not secrets but are kept as references because a template cannot hold per-user plain values in env (params fill the command only). If lotr gains params-in-env, these three could become params.
Arguments of list_schemas and the other reads were not checked against tools/list; read-tier assumptions rest on tool names and the prebuilt YAML.
Whether execute_sql refuses multiple statements was not checked in source (the description says a single statement).
The npm pin rests on the registry; the docs show the command unpinned.
